They are referred to as datasets A, B and C and can be found at https://github.com/felix-last/evaluate-kmeans-smote/releases/download/v0.0.2/toy_ AC datasets.tar.gz.

Further facilitating practical use, an implementation of k-means SMOTE in the Python programming language is made available (see https://github.com/felix-last/kmeans_smote) based on the imbalanced-learn framework [30].
